skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of financial management, compare different business models, analyze financial management issues, especially those related to the hospitality industry.
Understand the impact of various taxes on businesses, including VAT, special consumption tax, and corporate income tax.
Read and interpret financial reports, particularly those relevant to the hospitality industry.
Manage costs and revenues effectively within a business.
Evaluate the effectiveness of projects through financial analysis.
Implement effective cash management strategies in hotels.
Manage short-term assets such as accounts receivable and inventory.
